name: Birds
description: Birds word search puzzles gather common English bird names and quiet watching words for adults and seniors — cardinal, chickadee, sparrow, dove, nest, chorus and dawn vocabulary — without cartoon mascots or wildlife-park brands. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays gentle and outdoors: beak, branch, flock, perch and song words birders already recognize. This hub pairs well with Birdwatching and Animals when you want a longer nature hour. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as calm as a garden sill.
